```{r}
library(opensr)
```

## Create project and protocol

```{r}
root <- file.path(tempdir(), "opensr-demo")
proj <- sr_project_create(root, name = "demo-review")

protocol <- sr_protocol_init("Demo protocol", "Does X improve Y?")
protocol <- sr_protocol_validate(protocol)
```

## Search log and records

```{r}
search <- sr_search_log_init()
search <- sr_search_add(search, source = "Scopus", query = "x AND y", n_results = 42)

records <- sr_import_csv(system.file("extdata", "toy_records.csv", package = "opensr"))
records <- sr_deduplicate(records)
records <- sr_records_validate(records)
```

## Screening and flow

```{r}
screen <- sr_screen_template(records, reviewers = c("alice", "bob"))
screen$data$decision_1 <- c("include", "exclude", "include")
screen$data$decision_2 <- c("include", "include", "include")
screen <- sr_screen_dual(screen)

screen <- sr_screen_resolve(
  screen,
  resolutions = data.frame(record_id = 2, final_decision = "exclude", resolver = "carol")
)

fulltext <- sr_fulltext_log(data.frame(record_id = 2, reason = "wrong population"))
flow <- sr_flow_data(records, screen, fulltext)
sr_prisma_flow(flow)$data
```

## Archive and reproducibility

```{r}
manifest <- sr_osf_manifest(root)
sr_archive_verify(manifest)

archive <- sr_archive_bundle(root)
repro <- sr_report_reproducibility(root)
```
